generationPrerequisites.notes: Full beta generation exposed the same two reference-deletion collisions already resolved by the reviewed v1.0 collision policy. Both profiles' published Remove-Mg(Beta)PrintShareAllowedGroupByRef and Remove-Mg(Beta)PrintShareAllowedUserByRef metadata records the collection $ref DELETE (including Delete/Delete1 variants). Extend only the existing exact item-DELETE suppressions to beta/no-data; retain collection GET/POST/DELETE. This is an explicit generation prerequisite, not an invented third shared directive or a new whole-collection suppression. Cross-path variant support remains subject to the existing reviewed policy.

New PrintPrinter Create/CreateExpanded are the ordinary collection POST print_CreatePrinter in both profiles. Reviewed original same-profile openApiDocs and current compatible specs select exactly this same method/path/operation-ID set after ID alignment; the compatible survivor set is complete. The distinct action print.printer_create is POST /print/printers/microsoft.graph.create in the original spec and POST /print/printers/create in the compatible spec; it remains available, and v1.0 derived naming exposes it as New-MgPrintPrinter. Existing parity-suppressions.v1.0.json already suppresses the ordinary POST with derived data enabled; one exact curated entry supplies the missing beta/no-data coverage without duplicate per-profile overrides. GeneratorConfig run settings are shared while explicit separate runtime profiles select derived data in tests. Printer GET, item PATCH/DELETE, job POST, and the create action remain available.
